why no row can produce it on a device: the Contacts provider decodes a photo when it is written, so no fixture can store an undecodable one (r3 V6)

Link / Unlink with another profile's contact is refused by the guard (fix-round F23), and no page offers it: a work-profile card has no Link action (E16 asserts its card's actions), so the refusal cannot be reached from the UI

no page offers a Sync the guard refuses: the picker lists only the calendars allowed on "Can sync to", and a synced event whose target left that list opens "Can sync to" instead of writing (E23, E24), so the refusal cannot be reached from the app

# alternative: [calendar] sync event=<id> -> calendar <id>: failed the copy could not be read
why no row can produce it on a device: a copy row the provider cannot return while its mapping stands cannot be made from adb: a copy deleted or moved on the other side reads as gone (recreated, E24) or stale (EDGE C04), never unreadable (fix-round F30)

# alternative: [calendar] reminders count from <ms> (the shell's start: the clock was set back behind <old>)
why no row can produce it on a device: the clock would have to go back while the shell is not running, and the system restarts the Home app within a second of a stop; set back under the running shell, the same rule logs its other form (EDGE C16: the clock was set: it went back behind <old>)
